annotations.summary: No finalized block for ten minutes
annotations.description: substrate_block_height{status="finalized"} has not moved in ten minutes. On a chain with a GRANDPA quorum this means finality is stopped, not slow: check peer counts and whether enough authorities are reachable.

annotations.summary: No block produced for five minutes
annotations.description: The best block height has not moved in five minutes while the process is up: authoring or the transaction pool is wedged.
An isolated validator cannot take part in finality. Compare against substrate_node_roles to tell a validator from an observer.
One of the scraped endpoints has been unreachable for two minutes: the metrics port is down, or the node is.
